Abjuration.description: Cloaked in shimmering wards and whispered mantras of guardianship, Abjurers dedicate themselves to shielding the Grand Library from the Shroud. Their studies echo with protective charms etched into the very stones of their sanctums, and they keep faith with the books others have long set aside.
Abjuration.benefit: Earn +$3 when you complete a quest with a book that has been on your TBR for over a year.

Divination.description: Keepers of Divination peer into pools of ink and read the shimmer of futures hidden within the margins. Their foresight is prized, for they glimpse truths beyond the turning of a page.
Divination.benefit: Once per month, you may roll 2 dice instead of 1 for a Monthly Quest, and choose which result you want to use.

Evocation.description: Sparks dance from their fingertips as Evokers study in fire-lit halls, conjuring storms and flame from words alone. Their passion for raw power blazes with every tale they consume.
Evocation.benefit: Once per month you may use one book to complete two quests, regardless of prompt

Enchantment.description: With soft voices and subtle gestures, Enchanters weave influence not only over wandering spirits but over the books themselves, coaxing stories to reveal their hidden depths.
Enchantment.benefit: When you face a monster in a dungeon, you earn +10 XP.

Conjuration.description: Conjurers summon echoes of beings and places from other times, filling their sanctums with flickering companions and phantom libraries. Their craft ensures no story is ever truly lost.

Transmutation.description: Focuses on the arcane art of alchemy, allowing the Keeper to shift the essence and value of their collected resources. You master the rare skill of converting one material into another, understanding that the value of every resource is fluid.
Transmutation.benefit: Once per month, you may transmute your resources: exchange 20 Dusty Blueprints for $2, or $2 for 20 Dusty Blueprints.
